title.ko: 사역·수동의 뉘앙스: have/get sth done · be said to · be reported to have · the passive of reporting
title.en: nuances of causatives and passives: have/get something done, be said to, be reported to have, reporting passives

explain.ko: 사역 have/get은 남에게 시킬 때 쓰며, have + 목적어 + 과거분사는 서비스를 받거나 불행한 일을 당했음을 나타냅니다. get someone to do는 설득의 뉘앙스를 가집니다. 신문과 학술 글에서는 It is said that ... 대신 He is said to be ... 같은 보도 수동태를 씁니다. 과거 사실은 to have + 과거분사로 나타냅니다. 이런 구조는 출처를 밝히지 않고도 객관성을 유지하게 해 줍니다.
explain.en: Causative have and get are used for having things done by others, and have + object + past participle expresses receiving a service or suffering a misfortune. Get someone to do carries a nuance of persuasion. In newspapers and academic writing, reporting passives such as He is said to be ... replace It is said that ... Past facts take to have + past participle. These structures keep an objective tone without naming sources.

lines.t: Have + object + past participle expresses having something done by someone else, or suffering a misfortune. In newspaper reports, reporting passives such as be said to and be reported to have are common. These forms let you convey information objectively without naming a source.

trans.ko: have + 목적어 + 과거분사는 남에게 시켜서 하게 하거나 불행한 일을 당했음을 나타냅니다. 신문 기사에서는 be said to, be reported to have 같은 보도 수동태가 많이 쓰입니다. 이 표현은 출처를 밝히지 않고도 정보를 객관적으로 전할 수 있게 해 줍니다.

task.model: I had my roof repaired last week. The building is said to have been built a hundred years ago. The contractor is reported to have already passed the contract to another firm. I got the contractor to bring the schedule forward.

model_trans.ko: 저는 지난주에 지붕을 수리받았어요. 그 건물은 백 년 전에 지어졌다고 알려져 있어요. 시공사는 이미 계약을 다른 회사에 넘겼다고 보도되었어요. 저는 업자를 설득해 일정을 앞당기게 했어요.
model_trans.en: I had my roof repaired last week. The building is said to have been built a hundred years ago. The contractor is reported to have already passed the contract to another firm. I got the contractor to bring the schedule forward.
